review_locator: PMCID:PMC3422812, Expression of E-selectin ligands on circulating tumor cells; PMCID:PMC3435295, Mac-2 Binding Protein Is a Novel E-Selectin Ligand Expressed by Breast Cancer Cells
primary_title: Mac-2 Binding Protein Is a Novel E-Selectin Ligand Expressed by Breast Cancer Cells
decision_basis: The reviews identify Mac-2 binding protein/LGALS3BP as an E-selectin ligand and the cited primary study validates its cell-surface E-selectin ligand activity by immunoprecipitation, mass spectrometry, E-selectin chimera binding, and shRNA-dependent flow adhesion.
limitations_preserved: Preserve cell-surface 72-kDa Mac-2BP glycoform, sialofucosylated epitope, breast-cancer model, and shear-flow context; no generalized secreted Mac-2BP receptor function or SCI inference.
